notes: FR12 is a modular 12RU hyperconverged SDI/IP routing frame with 16 blade slots and NO fixed video I/O of its own — all signal I/O is provided by field-installable blades (ULTRIX-HDX-IO, -IP-IO, -IPX-IO, -MODX-IO, -SFP-IO), so actual port count/type varies per configuration. Ports listed here are: (1) the base-chassis fixed connectors (ENET x2, USB-A front, USB-B rear, ALARM, REF A/B) that exist on every FR12 regardless of blade fit, and (2) one representative ULTRIX-HDX-IO blade (16x16 HD-BNC SDI, the flagship/most common blade, populating slot 1) shown as representative signal I/O — a fully populated frame can have up to 16 such blades (288x288 max). SDI grade is sdi-12g since inputs/outputs support 270Mb/s through 12Gb/s (UHD) per blade, gated by an UltriSpeed license for 12G. AUX ports on each blade are unpopulated from the factory and accept SFP+ modules (3G/12G SDI coax or optical, MADI, or HDMI/DVI SFPs) — modeled here as "sfp" connector, grade omitted since the grade depends on which SFP module is installed. Power: the FR12 itself has no AC inlet — it has 4 rear "PSU" power-input modules (Molex mini-fit-style multi-pin DC connectors, closest listed enum is dc-barrel) that each mate to one channel of an external Ross Ultripower 1RU supply (15VDC, up to 300W per connector); a minimum of two Ultripower units is required, and the Ultripower units themselves take standard IEC C14 AC mains (90-240VAC) — that AC inlet lives on the separate Ultripower accessory, not on the FR12 chassis, so it is omitted here. USB Type-A (front) is reserved for future use; USB Type-B (rear) is for recovery/service only via USB-serial adapter, not a general host/device data port. ALARM is a 3-pin terminal block relay output (closest enum match is euroblock) not a locking multi-pin connector. LTC and R-OUT ports on the Frame Control Module are physically present but explicitly "not implemented" per the installation guide, so they were omitted. Frame height measured at 21.0in = 12U, consistent with "FR12" naming.
